response.original_title: 女美容師の生下着・快感
response.overview: A stylish hair salon in Harajuku. The busier the salon gets, the hotter the female hairstylists feel inside. They're so attentive to their clients that by the time work is over, they're completely exhausted. At times like these, they crave a man... It doesn't matter if it's love, or even if he's a friend's fiancé! A man is there beside them, in front of them, in bed. Those are the only conditions for sex.
response.title: 女美容師の生下着・快感
